combo_label: Around the House × At the Funfair × Castles & Medieval Life

entries.clue: Little electric cars with rubber skirts, steered straight at your mates
Two riders thundering at each other on opposite sides of a wooden rail
Field labourer tied to the land, handed on with it whenever it changed owners
Water-filled ditch that made scaling ladders useless and tunnelling a drowning risk
Honey-fermented drink raised in the hall long before hops came into fashion
Strip you step over on the way in, and a limit that must be crossed
Ribbed panel that warms a room, and dries socks in a pinch
Cool space below the ground floor, traditional keeper of wine
Stone floor the fire sits on, once the centre of the household
Drum ride that pins you to the wall as the floor drops away
Wooden-headed basher for croquet, or for ringing the strength-test bell
Funhouse fixture that stretches and squashes your reflection
